ValidationRule.description: This validation will trigger, if the Credit Verifier is trying to approve/ Decline/ Return to Evaluator the case, before the Credit Evaluator has Approved
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: TEXT(Type ) = 'Credit Card Application' && TEXT(Sub_Type__c) = 'New Credit Card' && (TEXT(cc_Credit_Verification_Result__c )='Approve' || TEXT(cc_Credit_Verification_Result__c )='Decline' || TEXT(cc_Credit_Verification_Result__c )='Return to Evaluator') && TEXT( cc_Credit_Evaluation_Result__c ) != 'Accept' && TEXT( cc_Credit_Evaluation_Result__c ) != 'Referred by Verifier'
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Credit Evaluator needs to action the Case, before Credit Verifier actions the Case.
